title: Fur pelt from strands along a flow field
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of animal fur: thousands of tapered strands combed along a smooth flow field, gathered into locks, with banded hairs and coat patterns (solid, tabby stripes, spots or rosettes). Use for creature and animal skins, fur trims, rugs, plush toys and stylized characters.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python fur_strands.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: thickness
parameters.meaning: Strand radius at the root in texture units (drawn at least about a pixel wide).

parameters.name: coverage
parameters.meaning: How many strands cover each point on average; low values show the undercoat.

parameters.name: swirl
parameters.meaning: How far the flow turns away from the main lie direction.

parameters.name: clumping
parameters.meaning: How strongly strand tips gather into locks.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.meaning: Coat pattern: 0 solid, 1 tabby stripes, 2 spots, 3 rosettes (dark rings).

parameters.name: banding
parameters.meaning: Colour change along each strand: darker root and a light band near the tip.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Brown tabby cat fur with dark stripes and banded hairs.

presets.name: leopard_rosettes
presets.description: Short golden pelt with dark rosettes.

presets.name: black_glossy
presets.description: Short glossy black fur lying flat.

presets.name: white_fluffy
presets.description: Long white fluffy fur parted into soft locks.

presets.name: dalmatian_spots
presets.description: Short white coat with round black spots.

limits: Fur is painted as flat strands in a height field, so it reads as fur lying flat seen from above; it is not hair geometry, cards or shells, and it has no silhouette fuzz, anisotropic hair shading or translucency. Strands are three straight segments each, so long fur looks combed rather than tangled. Coat patterns are stylized periodic fields (stripes, spots, rings), not species markings. Strands are drawn at least about a pixel wide, so the strand count drops at small sizes. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate.
technique_references: Periodic noise flow field around a main lie direction
Strand tracing in three steps along the flow
Clump attraction of strand tips on a jittered clump grid
Z-buffered tapered capsule painting with wrap-around
Coat pattern sampled at each strand root
Agouti banding as a colour band along the strand
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
